*.title: Northwind Freight raises $40M Series C to expand into Mexico
*.content: Northwind Freight, the Chicago-based freight brokerage, raised a $40 million Series C to open three new entities in Mexico.
*.raw_content: Northwind Freight, the Chicago-based freight brokerage, raised a $40 million Series C to open three new entities in Mexico. The company says it now works with more than 4,000 carriers.

*.title: Dana Whitfield on scaling finance at Northwind Freight
*.content: Dana Whitfield, CFO of Northwind Freight, says the finance team is processing three times the invoices it did last year.

draft.subject: 3x the invoices, same team
draft.body:
Dana,

In your CFO Dive interview you said Northwind is processing three times the invoices it did last year with the same team. With three new Mexican entities on the way after the Series C, that load usually grows again.

Ledgerline automates invoice capture and PO matching; customers typically automate 70-80% of invoice matching within 90 days.

Would a one-page teardown of how that would look for a multi-entity setup be useful?

Alex at Ledgerline
